chunks: 1351 - Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said to me:

“When a man rests on his right side, he should say: ‘In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I have submitted my soul to You, turned my face toward You, entrusted my affair to You, sought support with my back in You, and relied upon You, in fear of You and in hope toward You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have sent down, and in Your Messenger whom You have sent.’
Then he should recite the tasbih of Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام.
And whoever is afflicted by fear at the time of sleep should recite, when he goes to his bed, the two protective surahs and Āyat al-Kursī.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: the Throne Verse, a Qur’anic verse recited for protection
key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: the two surahs of seeking refuge, Sūrat al-Falaq and Sūrat al-Nās
key_terms.تَسْبِيحَ: glorification and prescribed words of dhikr
key_terms.تَوَسَّدَ: rested or lay down using something as support, here lying for sleep
key_terms.تَوَكَّلْتُ: I relied and placed my trust upon Allah
key_terms.فَوَّضْتُ: I entrusted and consigned my affair to Allah

ai.seo_question: What should a person recite before sleeping according to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a recommended supplication and dhikr to be recited before sleep while lying on one’s right side. It emphasizes surrender to Allah, trust in Him, and seeking refuge in Him, and it also recommends the Tasbih of Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام and recitation of al-Muʿawwidhatayn and Āyat al-Kursī for protection from fear at night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1351 - Al-'Ala reported from Muhammad ibn Muslim that Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said to me:

"When a man places his right side (for sleep), he should say:
'In the Name of Allah (swt). O’ Allah (swt), I have submitted my soul to You, turned my face towards You, entrusted my affairs to You, and placed my reliance upon You, in fear of You and in hope of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book, which You have revealed, and in Your Messenger, whom You have sent.'
Then he should recite the Tasbih of Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}.
If someone experiences fear at bedtime, they should recite the two protective chapters (al-Mu'awwidhatayn) and Ayat al-Kursi (The Verse of the Throne)."
